digest_entries.delta_md: GPT-5.6 is now available in Kiro. OpenAI says it helps developers plan, build, review, and test software. The launch is framed as improving price-performance.
OpenAI banned Russia-origin accounts using AI to promote a fake Israel-based think tank and a "sovereignty" index praising Russia and criticizing the West.
OpenAI published first results for Jalapeño, its custom inference chip. OpenAI said it delivers faster, more power-efficient AI inference, with higher throughput and lower latency for modern models.
OpenAI published findings on the Hugging Face security incident. It said it is taking steps to strengthen AI model security, monitoring, and alignment.
OpenAI said ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems. The expansion brings secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.
OpenAI said it is expanding its presence in Brazil and is deepening engagement with developers, businesses, and communities. OpenAI framed the expansion as support for AI adoption across the country.
OpenAI said it will wind down its contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor. OpenAI said the decision follows Cursor's acquisition by SpaceX.
